title: Provider pricing override layer for dsh-model-pricing
description: Per-provider (billing-channel) pricing over the model base table. Each entry is resolved to an effective rate (the number the ledger should bill/value at) plus a billing class, so a consumer can separate REAL metered spend from SUBSCRIPTION value. A record priced as (provider, model) looks up its provider here first, falling back to the model base table when the provider has no entry.

version.description: Bump when pricing semantics change; consumers re-fetch on change.

currency.description: All amounts are RMB per million tokens (metered rows).

usdExchangeRate.description: RMB per USD, for display of USD-denominated plans.

provider.description: Provider route key as recorded in the ledger (e.g. deepseek-official, opencode-go, commandcode, zai, staryears).

model.description: Exact model string as recorded under this provider (may carry a provider prefix, e.g. deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash).

billing.description: metered: a REAL per-token spend (official API or relay/reseller at its own rate). subscription: included in a plan — the rate below is the VALUE the plan creates (what it would cost metered), NOT actual spend. Consumers must keep these two classes apart when summing spend.

rate.description: Effective rate this channel resolves to (RMB / per million tokens). For billing=metered it is the charge to record; for billing=subscription it is the metered-equivalent value for the plan-value estimate (never actual spend). Resolved by the build from the base table (inherited or via ref) or taken verbatim from a hand-written override.

rateSource.description: inherited: copied from the base table under this exact model string. ref: copied from the base table under the modelId named by the entry's ref. explicit: hand-written channel rate. zero: default ¥0 (unknown model string, awaiting the user).

note.description: Human note (terms reference, caveat, date checked).
